author: UFC / Zuffa LLC studio portrait (served by ESPN)
notes: Sharp frontal studio headshot with the heavyweight belt: buzz cut with a lined-up hairline, full black beard with grey at the chin. Best image for the eyes, brows, forehead marks, nose and lips. Warm, saturated studio grade.

author: UFC / Zuffa LLC studio portrait (served by ESPN)
notes: Full-body studio cutout at heavyweight (UFC 309 era) in black and red Venum shorts with 'Philippians 4:13' and 'JONES'. Shows the current heavier physique; the belt hides most of the chest.

author: UFC / Zuffa LLC studio portrait (served by ESPN)
date_taken: Light-heavyweight era, before 2021 (CDN Last-Modified 2021-02-02; Reebok kit)
notes: Full-body studio cutout at light heavyweight in grey Reebok shorts: lean with a clear six-pack. Clearest view of both torso tattoos ('Philippians 4:13' script and the two Chinese characters).

author: Commons uploader NomadPHY (claimed); appears to be an official UFC studio portrait
license: Tagged CC BY-SA 4.0 on Commons, but the claim is doubtful
date_taken: Probably 2023 (heavyweight title belt; Commons date field 2024-04-28)
notes: High-resolution frontal studio portrait with the heavyweight belt on a neutral grey background. Best image for the ears (thickened cartilage), the chest script and chest hair, and the most neutral studio skin colour. Marked reference-only: it looks like UFC photography uploaded as 'own work', so do not rely on the CC BY-SA tag.

author: Kirby Lee, Imagn Images
notes: ESPYs red carpet, most recent clear photo (retired since mid-2025). Face turned slightly to his right, smiling; short buzz with receding temples, beard trimmed to about 5 mm with grey on the chin, small red stud in the left ear. Magenta backdrop cast on the skin.

author: Chris Unger, Zuffa LLC via Getty Images (EXIF copyright 2024 Zuffa LLC)
notes: UFC 309 octagon close-up, three-quarter view of his right side: head shaved smooth for the fight, full beard, right ear, the 'Philippians' script. Arena light, deep shadows.

author: Getty Images (as credited by SportBible)
notes: Second UFC 309 octagon frame, face nearer frontal with the head tilted. Saved as a 256-colour PNG, so do not sample colours from it.

author: Jake Noecker, Cageside Press
notes: UFC 309 official weigh-in, flexing double biceps, smiling, frontal: heavyweight upper body, 'Philippians 4:13' script, buzz cut. Small (711 px).

author: United States Senate Democrats
license: Public domain (as tagged on Commons; the uncropped Flickr original 'Jon Jones - Supporting Brain Health Study.jpg' is CC BY 2.0)
attribution: United States Senate Democrats, public domain, via Wikimedia Commons
notes: Frontal at a U.S. Senate event, even indoor light, goatee and moustache, short curly top. 12 years old, but the best freely licensed face and a neutral skin reference.

author: Vengo Films (video still)
attribution: Vengo Films, CC BY 3.0, via Wikimedia Commons
notes: Gym shot, hands on hips, head turned to his left: near-profile of the right side of the face and the right ear, plus a lean light-heavyweight torso with the 'Philippians' script. Old (2015) and video-soft.
